Uses of Interface
jmt.jmch.simulation.Simulation

Packages that use Simulation
Package
Description
jmt.jmch
The JMCH tool: a modelling classroom helper that applies a simulation technique to solve single station models, as described in the user manual.
jmt.jmch.animation
Animation of the JMCH tool: animated queues, routers, stations and edges used to visualize the scheduling and routing algorithms during their execution.
jmt.jmch.simulation
Simulation engine of JMCH: single station simulation of the scheduling algorithms and network simulation of the routing algorithms.
jmt.jmch.wizard
Wizard of the JMCH tool: step by step definition of the station or network to be simulated.
jmt.jmch.wizard.panels
Panels of the JMCH wizard.
